title: guneria sosnovskyi
intro: Guneria sosnovskyi, commonly known as Guneria or Kalmegh, is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Guneria sosnovskyi include its immunomodulatory, antioxidant, and anti-ulcerative properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Guneria sosnovskyi include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
